items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: you listen to Perry Como, you listen to Bing Crosby

ctx.x: They are coming back. Look at Bing Crosby. You walk out there, you listen to Perry Como, you listen to Bing Crosby, you listen to the different old artists, and what a pleasure-- what a pleasure. Now, that will take me back to theaters. I stopped going for a while. But I'll go back to the theater if I --
